svg.title: Shoshin: Lichtfeld × Uchiha
svg.desc: The moon of the Infinite Tsukuyomi is split down the middle: Rinne Sharingan on Itachi’s side, Rinnegan on Sasuke’s, nine tomoe turning over both, a red wave of light rolling out. Itachi and Sasuke stand on either side, their Susanoo floating above them as holograms drawn in points of light, Itachi’s with mirror and blade, Sasuke’s with horns and twin blades, joined by a pulsing thread of light; crows dissolve into feathers, cherry blossom petals drift, black flames burn.
